crossRefs.note: Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’
If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.
The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—
We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ…
but I hope to see you soon. Then we will speak face to face. Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends…

parallels.note: Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’

translations.web: As you enter into the household, greet it.
translations.bsb: As you enter the home, greet its occupants.
translations.kjv: And when ye come into an house, salute it.
translations.asv: And as ye enter into the house, salute it.
